title: MemoryFeatures
description: Volatile memory forensic artifacts, Virtual Address Descriptor (VAD) properties, and page entropy metrics for the Memory modality (Track A). Scored by CatBoost upon partial dump trigger.

rwx_page_count.description: Count of committed memory regions with PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE permissions

injected_code_regions.description: Regions with write/execute permissions containing MZ header or raw assembly code without backing image file on disk

unmapped_executable_pages.description: Executable memory regions not mapped to any valid PE file on disk (private memory execution)

vad_protection_anomaly_count.description: VAD nodes where initial allocation protection differs from current protection (VirtualProtect manipulation)

ldrmodules_inconsistencies.description: Discrepancies across InLoadOrder, InMemoryOrder, and InInitOrder module lists indicating unhooked/reflective injection

yara_shellcode_matches.description: Count of matched memory signatures against standard shellcode and reflective loader YARA rules

mean_memory_entropy.description: Average Shannon entropy across all inspected executable/private memory pages (high entropy indicates encrypted payload)

max_memory_entropy.description: Peak Shannon entropy observed in any single suspect memory page
